title: mTORC1 signaling in group 2 innate lymphoid cells coordinates neuro-immune crosstalk in allergic lung inflammation
core_idea: Investigate how mTORC1 signaling in lung group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) enables integration of environmental cues by modulating NMUR1 expression via epigenetic reprogramming, and how this regulates ILC2 responsiveness to the neuropeptide neuromedin U in the context of allergic lung inflammation.
tldr: Study aims to define the role of mTORC1 in lung ILC2s as a molecular hub linking epigenetic regulation of NMUR1 to neuro-immune interactions with neuromedin U during allergic asthma in a mouse model.
